status: candidate-only replay-entry graph contract; not an executable n8n export

envelope.name: Build Shopify Replay Envelope
envelope.payload_event_id: source_event_id (the delivery ID), never X-Shopify-Event-Id or body.id

shared_pipeline.normalizer_change: Copy only top-level $json.replay_context to normalized output. Public webhook payload is nested under $json.body and cannot set this top-level property.
shared_pipeline.tenant_binding: After Bind Tenant Context, compare resolved tenant_id with replay_context.tenant_id; mismatch or lookup error stops before any mutation.
shared_pipeline.hmac: Replay entry bypasses Verify Shopify HMAC only because loader proves ingress_hmac_verified=true on tenant-bound stored row. Public ingress always runs receive_shopify_webhook_v1 HMAC verification.
shared_pipeline.classify: Classify Result accepts a second input from replay branch and emits __proceed=true, __webhook_id=loaded.webhook_id only after tenant equality succeeds; normal ingress branch still requires explicit durable acknowledgement classifier.
shared_pipeline.downstream: All 18 mutation nodes dispatch to matching *_fenced RPCs when replay_context is present, with job_id, worker_id, lease_id first. A pre-write renew_shopify_replay_lease(job_id,worker_id,lease_id,180) must return a confirmed expiry before the first business write; every later write still validates the lease transactionally.

ingress_cutover.public_shopify_path: Validate required Shopify headers and raw body; call henvalt.receive_shopify_webhook_v1(text,text,text,text,text,jsonb,jsonb); classify only its explicit row; respond exactly once using Respond to Webhook; terminate the Shopify path.
ingress_cutover.identity: X-Shopify-Webhook-Id is the unique delivery identity. Do not fall back to X-Shopify-Event-Id, body.id or correlation ID.
ingress_cutover.event_identity: For public Shopify ingress, normalized source_event_id is always X-Shopify-Webhook-Id (delivery identity), never X-Shopify-Event-Id or body.id. A replay envelope reconstructs the same identity from the stored source_event_id.

lifecycle.processed: mark_webhook_processed_fenced(job_id,worker_id,lease_id,webhook_id) must return true before the subflow exposes top-level mark_webhook_processed=true.
lifecycle.failed: mark_webhook_failed_fenced receives a constant non-PII reason for replay; recovery worker owns bounded retry/dead-letter.
lifecycle.lease: Renew only for early loss detection; transaction-local fenced wrappers remain mandatory.
lifecycle.deferred_payment: A successful defer_payment_webhook_reconciliation_fenced(...)=true is a durable terminal handoff, not a processed webhook. The subflow exposes top-level deferred_payment_handoff=true only after the RPC returns true. HENVALT_RECOVERY may complete the replay job on mark_webhook_processed=true OR deferred_payment_handoff=true. The existing every-minute reconciler subsequently processes, reschedules or dead-letters the payment webhook.

deferred_payment_audit.selection: FAILED + payment_reconciliation_pending=true + next_at<=now(); FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

acceptance: Valid stored replay row creates canonical envelope with delivery ID as event_id.
Claim/load job, worker, lease tuple mismatch stops before any downstream node.
Expired lease, missing ingress HMAC attestation, wrong shop, wrong tenant, malformed payload stop before mutation.
Replay branch bypasses external HMAC call only after trusted DB load; public ingress always verifies raw-body HMAC.
Public ingress returns 200 only after durable webhook and active replay job IDs are confirmed.
A 409, missing webhook ID, missing replay job ID, or terminal replay state returns 503, never a false 200.
All replay business writes call only the mapped fenced wrappers with exact lease tuple and sequential ordering.
Already processed webhook completes without re-running projections.
Webhook processed marker returns true before replay subflow reports success.
No replay branch reaches HENVALT_DELIVERY or a provider request node.

Deferred payment path: fenced defer RPC returns true; webhook becomes FAILED with payment_reconciliation_pending=true; the existing every-minute recovery reconciler later processes or reschedules it; replay job completes only after this durable handoff is confirmed.
The recovery workflow completes the replay job only when the ingest subflow returns mark_webhook_processed=true or deferred_payment_handoff=true.
dependencies: Rewire every mutation node to conditional fenced dispatch and audit all SQL/HTTP nodes for unlisted writes.
Use a disposable isolated database and isolated n8n draft only after cost approval; no paused project restore is implied.
Keep provider sending default-deny and use network-denied stubs.
Test the deferred-payment handoff with the existing Every Minute recovery node and assert pending metadata, subsequent reconciler pickup, and eventual PROCESSED/retry/dead-letter state.
Run n8n import/schema validation against the generated offline candidate and rebind Supabase service-role credentials only in an isolated draft.
